answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 32608 Country: India Title: Nikah is haram or haral Question: In one friendnd nikah khani Bareli kazi spell defferent karma a taiba as original .He spell " lailaha illah sayedna mohammadan yasor allah" it is allow in islam to add something as u wish, & what will be fatwa on that kazi it remain musliim or not & what will me the fatwa on that nikah it is right to islam or not, if nikah is wrong what will be taken step Answer ID: 32608 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1006/603/L=1432) No addition in the Kalimah Tayyiba is right. However, the nikah was valid. Until we do not receive any explanation from the Qazi about his intention in saying Ya Rasulullah, we cannot have a say. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
